description: How the WYSIWYG canvas treats the images a template references (Fáze 9A). The editor canvas is the one place where a template's remote images become requests from the AUTHOR's browser: an imported template can carry a per-recipient tracking pixel, and a host editing a template it did not author may not want that request made from the editor at all. Load is the default — the canvas is a preview and the author is writing the email, so a missing picture would be the more surprising behaviour. Only URLs the pipeline's allow-list accepted are ever requested.

members.name: Load
members.description: Load the image in an after the pipeline's URL allow-list accepted it (the default). The rendered email loads the same source anyway, so this is the faithful preview.

members.name: Placeholder
members.description: Never issue a request from the editor: paint a framed placeholder with the alt text instead. Use it for privacy (no tracking pixel from an author's browser) or on a metered connection.
